title: MURCIÉLAGO Anime Sets January 2027 Release
content:
The TV anime adaptation of Kana Yoshimura’s MURCIÉLAGO will officially begin broadcasting and streaming in January 2027. The announcement was made at Anime NYC, narrowing its previously announced 2027 release window. The adaptation was announced in July during Anime Expo 2026.

HIDIVE also confirmed the January 2027 release date for its exclusive simulcast in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Ireland, Australia, and New Zealand.

The adaptation will be led by Takashi Naoya ( Am I Actually the Strongest? , Tales of Wedding Rings ) as chief director, with Matsuo Asami serving as director. The anime is a joint production between Satelight and Staple Entertainment.

The previously announced staff includes:

• Original work: Kana Yoshimura

• Chief Director: Takashi Naoya

• Director: Matsuo Asami

• Series Composition: Takashi Naoya

• Character Design: Sei Tateishi

• Music: Masanori Akita, Yuichi Tsuchiya

• Animation Production: Satelight × Staple Entertainment

MURCIÉLAGO has been serialized by Square Enix since August 2013, and the manga surpassed 2.3 million copies in circulation worldwide and currently has 28 volumes in Japan and 26 internationally. The story follows Kuroko Koumori, a former death row inmate selected through extraordinary legal measures to become a government-sanctioned executioner. Partnered with expert driver Hinako Tozakura, the pair investigate and eliminate some of society’s most dangerous criminals in a violent crime-action story blending dark humor, action, and horror.

You can watch the super teaser trailer below.

title: J-Novel Club Licenses 10 Light Novels, 1 Manga
content:
J-Novel Club announced licenses for 10 light novel series and one manga at its Anime NYC panel on Saturday. The first two parts of the first volume for all new light novel series and the first chapter for the new manga are available now. The company also revealed print releases for the following five titles:

• J-Novel Club Original Light Novel Contest winner Quadrilian's Beautiful Daydream light novel (illustrations by Ixy) — March 2027

• Tamura Mutō's Private Tutor to the Duke's Daughter manga (original work by Riku Nanano) — March 2027

• Ryuyu's Now I'm a Demon Lord! Happily Ever After with Monster Girls in My Dungeon omnibus 1 (volumes 1-2) light novel (illustrations by Daburyu) — March 2027

• Mao Nishiura's Pens Down, Swords Up: Throw Your Studies to the Wind light novel (illustrations by Maro) — April 2027

• Riku Misora's Chivalry of a Failed Knight (illustrations by Won) Collector's Edition 1 (volumes 1-3) light novel — April 2027

J-Novel Club 's new manga license is:

Now forced to confront his mother's remarriage with no way out, he finds himself with a new family and a new stepbrother, the gloomy and withdrawn Fuyuki. Yet beneath that intimidating exterior lies a gentle, guitar-loving soul.

As Fuyuki helps Kodai overcome his fear of performing, gratitude deepens into something far deeper—and far more complicated. But when it comes time for Kodai to help Fuyuki face the trauma that silenced his own music, will their bond strike a powerful new chord or will it collapse beneath the pressure?

J-Novel Club 's new light novel licenses includes:

Bewildered at first, Alphonse soon becomes determined to make Akito see his creations' true worth. Concealing his royal identity, Alphonse starts visiting the café where Akito works, closing the distance between them little by little. The closer they grow, the harder it is to keep his heart—and his hands—to himself.

There, she's prepared for a life of hardship living with Duke Julius Graz—a man so cruel that it earned him the moniker of the “unmelting ice sculpture.” But the cold and heartless man Claudia expected to meet is nowhere to be found. Instead, he welcomes her with warmth in food, new clothes, and kindness she thought she'd never again receive.

With Julius on her side, Claudia works to overcome the wounds of her past and find the confidence to clear her name. And maybe, just maybe, find a new home where she can truly belong.

The crown prince's dramatics awaken something buried deep within her: memories of her past life as a mighty sorceress, along with a powerful gift waiting to be used. With her newfound knowledge and power, Anrietta decides to set out and start anew. First, though, she'll need a servant—one who will never betray her the way those she trusted did in this life...or the last."

With Subaru's savvy showmanship and Nodoka's ridiculous speed, the two form an unlikely team. Now these two girls are racing to the big leagues hand in hand—and leaving their competition in the dust!

Everything changes when a trap sends Maya straight into an encounter with a deadly S-rank monster. Jin steps in without a second thought, unaware that his incredible feat has just been broadcast live to the world. Suddenly on the fast track to becoming a streaming sensation, Jin is about to discover what surprises await him in a modern world with a magical twist.

On the verge of death, Freesia learns the soul-crushing truth: her fiancé, Vute, has betrayed her. Her beloved younger sister, Kalmia, has yet again taken something precious from her. Then Freesia opens her eyes and finds herself two years in the past.

With a second chance at life, she resolves to cast aside everything Kalmia once stole from her—her engagement, the people who abandoned her, and the life that led to her ruin. This time, she'll live on her own terms.

There is just one problem. For some reason, Vute refuses to let go of their betrothal, and little by little, Freesia finds herself backed into a corner...

Fortunately, Renee's tough previous life has sharpened her resolve. Armed with an iron will, she's determined to climb the ranks, win over one of the love interests, and rewrite her fate. If only her elite and estranged older brother would stop inserting himself into every corner of his “amnesiac” sister's life! Can Renee beat the odds and claw her way to the top? And what is that her brother seems to be hiding?

ANN's coverage of Anime NYC 2026 is sponsored by Yen Press. Whether it's light novels, manga, or manhwa, Yen Press has everything you might want to add to your reading shelves! Visit Booth #1701 or YenPress.com for more information!

title: Crunchyroll’s Biggest Action Fantasy Returns With New Look Ahead of Season 3
content:
Crunchyroll is the largest streaming hub for anime fans across the globe, and it’s home to countless acclaimed series. One of the most stand-out hits on the platform is Wistoria: Wand and Sword , an action fantasy series centering around Will Serfort. Based on a manga written by Fujino Omori and illustrated by Aoi Toshi, the anime debuted in 2024 and became a major global hit. The second season was confirmed right after, and it also reached its conclusion this year. While the third season is currently under production , the anime hasn’t shared any major updates for fans. However, the anime returned with a range of new visuals to hype up the release of the second season’s Blu-ray. The official website confirms that it will be released in two volumes, and the first one will be out on August 26th, 2026.

However, the date is only for Japanese fans, and it will take at least a few months or even longer to release it internationally. Apart from including Episodes 13-18, the Blu-ray also comes with its set of bonuses, including new visuals, a booklet consisting of storyboards, design materials, the first part of an original story written by Omori, and many more surprises. The Blu-ray cover features Will Serfort in his unusual transformation, which he gained after borrowing Elfaria’s powers during the Terminalia in the first part of the second season.

Does Wistoria: Wand and Sword Season 3 Have a Release Date?

The third season was officially confirmed in June this year , right after the second season’s finale was broadcast. Since it’s only been a few weeks, the anime hasn’t shared any updates on the upcoming season, not even a release window. Since the second season took around two years to be released after the first season’s finale, we can expect around the same waiting time for the next installment as well. Since the first two seasons are streaming on Crunchyroll, we can expect the next season to land there as well.

The anime even released a new visual during the announcement. Featuring Will Serfort, the visual teases a major twist in the upcoming season since one of his eyes is glowing strangely. Not only that, but he is also surrounded by a different kind of flower on each side. The right side is kind of familiar to the red spider lily, a flower famously associated with death.

Wistoria: Wand and Sword Season 3 Will Be More Intense Than Ever

The story finally took shape in the second season when the truth about Will’s origins came to light. Not only that, but the villains have been making a move to cause chaos before the fated day. While their plan during the Terminalia failed, the damage they caused was devastating. There’s a traitor in the Tower of the Magia Vander , where only the world’s most elite Mages are allowed entry. This means that not only is the traitor a high Mage, but their power could also be more impressive than we realize. The third season is expected to unravel the mystery behind the traitor and the true reason behind their actions.

title: Major Isekai Confirms Release Date for Season 2 Return After 4 Years – Watch the Trailer
content:
A major Isekai anime franchise has finally confirmed its release date for Season 2 after four long years of waiting, and HIDIVE has dropped a new trailer showing it off ahead of its big premiere. It’s been a very strong year for Isekai anime as not only have fans gotten to see a number of new releases , but there have also been many returning franchises that have come back for new episodes as well. There are still more Isekai sequels slated to release through the rest of the year, and one is releasing earlier than the others.

The anime adaptation for Yuu Tanaka and LLO’s Reincarnated as a Sword originally made its debut back in 2022, and it’s finally coming back with a second season of episodes this Fall after four long years. Hosting an early premiere for fans in attendance at a special panel during the Anime NYC 2026 event this weekend, Reincarnated as a Sword Season 2 confirmed it’s going to be making its full premiere this October. Check out the trailer below.

When Does Reincarnated as a Sword Season 2 Coming Out?

Reincarnated as a Sword Season 2 will be making its debut on September 30th in Japan followed by an October 7th full launch, and it will be exclusively streaming its episodes with HIDIVE as part of their stacked Fall 2026 anime schedule for fans in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Ireland, Australia, New Zealand and more. This new trailer for the season also confirmed the new opening theme titled “Dream of Butterfly” as performed by FZMZ, and a new ending theme titled “Baribari Buddy” as performed by Hanabie.

Reincarnated as a Sword Season 2 is going to feature a returning staff and voice cast from the first season as well with Shinji Ishihira directing for C2C. Takahiro Nagano will be providing the scripts, Atsuko Saito will be providing the character designs, and Yasuharu Takanashi will be composing the music. The core voice cast is set to return with Ai Kakuma as Fran, Shinichiro Miki as Master, Yuma Uchida as Jean du Vix confirmed thus far. Vix appeared at the end of the first season, so we’re about to see more from the mysterious sorcerer.

What’s So Special About Reincarnated as a Sword?

HIDIVE has some big Isekai franchises that fans have gotten to see through the year thus far, and even more are in the works for the near future . You might not be up to date with all of their projects as of this time, but they definitely have some of the more unique Isekai experiences. That’s the case for Reincarnated as a Sword as the series not only saw their main character reincarnated into an inanimate sword, but placed him into the hands of a young slave fighting oppression.

Even with all of the other new Isekai releases coming this Fall , you’ll want to keep this one on your radar. It’s been such a long time since that first season, and it’s certainly a cool one as it’s yet another all powerful Isekai protagonist where its lead character is actually just a weapon another person is wielding. The two have developed a strong bond, so make sure to catch up with Reincarnated as a Sword with HIDIVE in the meantime.

title: Attack on Titan’s Original Studio Returns to the Anime for Special New Launch
content:
The original studio behind Attack on Titan has returned to the anime franchise for a special new event coming later this Fall. It’s been quite a while since Attack on Titan’ s anime and manga runs came to an end, but you wouldn’t really think that was the case given how active the franchise has been recently either way. But while studios like MAPPA have taken the reins of the franchise since, there’s an even bigger surprise now that the original studio behind it all has returned for a new event.

WIT Studio has officially announced that they are spearheading a new Attack on Titan cafe coming to Japan this Fall , and the biggest aspect of this is the fact that the studio is returning to the franchise to provide new art for the situation as well. It means a classic take on the characters in a very long time given that it had been with MAPPA for its final few seasons, and could tease even more of WIT Studio projects for the franchise in the future.

Attack on Titan Announces New Event With Original Anime Studio

“Attack on Titan Cafe for That Time of Life -A Teenage Dinner-” has been officially announced as a new event for the franchise from WIT Studio coming to Japan later this September, and it’s going to feature new art exclusive for the event. This includes a makeover for each of the headliner characters, and this is a pretty big deal since we’ve seen them through MAPPA’s lens for the last few years of the anime’s run . And that’s the run that most fans think back on most fondly when looking at the anime’s history on a whole.

WIT Studio’s time with Attack on Titan ended following the end of the third season . MAPPA then took over the anime adaptation beginning with its fourth and final season. The series then continued for a few more years after as this final season was expanded into multiple feature film releases and much more over the course of its grand finale. But with WIT Studio returning to the franchise in this way, there’s all sorts of potential for the anime to return with something else in the future.

Will Attack on Titan’s Anime Ever Return?

Attack on Titan is pretty much done as done could be. All of the manga has since been adapted and Hajime Isayama has publicly moved on from the franchise in the years since that finale. The manga had a very divisive ending, but the anime’s adaptation of that finale was received better by fans. It’s such a big and popular franchise even after that grand finale that MAPPA had been finding ways to keep working with the anime adaptation with other sorts of spinoff and side projects.

In a world where anime projects make their return for new reboots, revivals, sequels and more years after their original endings, there could be all sorts of ways for Attack on Titan to come back with new anime releases in the future. It could pick up with a new story years after, fill in more of the gaps in the past, or even more potential ideas if a studio staff wants to take it on. For now, catch up with Attack on Titan with platforms like Crunchyroll and more.

title: Crunchyroll’s Biggest Isekai Shocks With Surprise Return After 10 Years
content:
The biggest Isekai now streaming with Crunchyroll has just shocked fans with a surprise return after ten long years, and it’s kicking off a huge new battle for the rest of the season. Re:Zero -Starting Life in Another World- has been one of Kadokawa’s biggest light novel turned Isekai anime sensations , and that’s been especially the case as the anime now celebrates its 10th anniversary. The fourth season of the anime is back in gear with its second half of episodes, and it’s on the cusp of a huge fight.

Re:Zero -Starting Life in Another World- Season 4 is now working its way through the Recapture Arc with its new episodes airing this Summer, but the latest episode just had one of its biggest shocks yet with the “return” of Rem for the first time in ten years. She had gone into a coma at the end of the first season following Gluttony’s attack, and she makes a special return to get Subaru ready to get back into the action.

Re:Zero Season 4 Finally Brings Back Rem, But There’s a Catch

Re:Zero -Starting Life in Another World- Season 4 Episode 13 sees Subaru dealing with a different version of the Sin of Gluttony within a strange white space. It’s revealed to be known as Og Ragna, the resting place for souls. It’s teased that Subaru had previously lost his memories in this space after being eaten by Gluttony, and he nearly succumbs to this all over again without some outside help. A version of Rem appears within this space and is able to reform herself thanks to the memories that Subaru had left over. And she gives him the motivation her so sorely needs.

Telling Subaru to stand up and to keep fighting, this is the first time that Rem has spoken any dialogue in the series since going into this coma at the end of the first season. It’s been ten long years since then, and if you don’t count her appearances in projects like Isekai Quartet , this is a return from Rem that fans have been wanting to see for a very long time. Which does further indicate just how big of a turning point that the anime is at this point.

What Does This Mean for Re:Zero’s Future?

title: Dragon Ball Super Remake Confirms Release Date for Next Major Update
content:
Dragon Ball Super is gearing up for its next major update for its new remake anime coming later this Fall, but only some lucky fans will be able to check it out. Dragon Ball Super is on the cusp of a major comeback as not only is the artist behind the manga offering up new pieces to keep the franchise alive , but the anime franchise is coming back with the first of a new wave of releases later this year. And it’s going to offer an enhanced version of the original TV series.

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus is an enhanced version of the original Dragon Ball Super TV series , and will be offering a new take on the Battle of Gods arc. Currently scheduled for a release later this Fall, there are all sorts of other updates that fans are still hoping to get before its release. It seems that next update is coming soon as the anime has announced it will be hosting a special panel at New York Comic Con 2026 this October. Which will hopefully lead to its premiere.

Dragon Ball Super Announces NYCC 2026 Panel

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus is currently scheduled to make its debut sometime this Fall, but has yet to confirm a release date for its launch as of this time. “Fall” usually means a release in October to air alongside a slate of new releases for the Fall 2026 anime schedule, but that’s not always the case. If there are fewer episodes than a usual cour, then the anime could kick off its run later in the year. That might be the case with this one considering it’s only been confirmed to cover the Battle of Gods and Resurrection F arcs .

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus has yet to confirm how many episodes this remake is going to run for, and the anime might have a new time slot altogether. There have been other new anime releases confirmed for the time slots that Dragon Ball Daima had when it aired, and when Dragon Ball Super first ran on TV, so there could be another shake up when it comes to this release. But this panel will likely reveal exactly when the anime will finally premiere. It’s kind of the final big opportunity to do so before the end of the year.

What’s Next for Dragon Ball Super?

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus is coming out later this Fall, and this NYCC 2026 panel is going to be the final major time that the franchise could update fans. There will be a chance later in year with Jump Festa 2027 scheduled for later this December , but by then hopefully we’ve already seen the remake in action. Anyway, there’s much more to look ahead to with Dragon Ball Super’ s future as there’s a brand new anime now in the works as well to take its story further through the manga and potentially beyond.

Dragon Ball Super: The Galactic Patrol is now in the works, but the anime has yet to confirm a potential release as of the time of this writing . It’s been teased that it might be coming our way 2027 or later, and is going to be adapting the Galactic Patrol Prisoner arc. This is an arc currently exclusive to the manga at this time, so it’s an exciting step forward for the franchise on a whole.

title: Nickelodeon Creator Shoots Down Revival Series Rumors
content:
Earlier this month, a former creator of the classic Nickelodeon revival teased that there were active discussions between the original team and Paramount. With the franchise not confirming any new projects since it returned to the screen in 2017, many animation enthusiasts were excited to see what would come next for the city-dwelling cast of colorful characters. Unfortunately, it appears as though the original statement from writer Joe Purdy wasn’t exactly what it seemed, as the original creator of the NickToon has gone on record to throw some cold water on the idea of Arnold and his crew making a return.

Hey Arnold! writer Joe Purdy recently stated that “we were having conversations,” hinting at the idea that the NickToon might receive a revival at Paramount. In a statement to shoot down the idea, original series creator Craig Bartlett shot down the idea that a revival series was in the works, going so far as to say that Purdy’s comments were ‘taken out of context.’ Specifically, Bartlett shared a new social media post that stated, “Here to tell you that the stories this week about being in talks with Paramount are not true. Joe made some comments that were taken out of context. Sorry, gang, but don’t worry, there’s lots of Arnold stuff to keep me busy all year!”

What’s Next For Arnold?

While Bartlett shot down the idea of a Hey Arnold! returning anytime soon, he has discussed the idea of bringing back the series and what the creative team might do should they return to the Nickelodeon universe. Most recently, Craig took part in an anniversary celebration for the series, discussing where Arnold might go should he hit the screen once again: “Obviously, it has to be something Nickelodeon wants. If we were to make something new for Nickelodeon, I would love to just pick up where we left off. I actually really tried to design Hey Arnold! The Jungle Movie to end not as a cliffhanger. I really wanted it to be resolved, but you know, Helga and Arnold know that they love each other now. So what’s gonna happen?”

If you’re wondering what Bartlett was referring to when mentioning how he was still busy with the franchise in 2026, this year will see a real-world tour , “ The Music of Hey Arnold! Live! ” Not only will musicians Jim Land and the PS118 AllStars be playing tracks from the Nickelodeon series, but Craig Bartlett will also be there to offer new insight into the creation of the NickToon. Beginning in California on October 26th, the tour will travel across the country before coming to an end this December. If you want to revisit the series proper, Hey Arnold! is currently streaming on Paramount+.

title: 10 Years Later, Bleach Just Shocked With Ichigo’s Brand New Bankai With Official Name From Creator
content:
Ten years after the original series came to an end, Bleach is still shocking fans with the debut of a brand new Bankai for Ichigo Kurosaki from the original creator making its debut in the latest episode. Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War is working its way through the final season of its episodes adapting Tite Kubo’s original manga, and the latest episode made one of the most significant changes to the manga’s original events yet with an extension to the fight between Ichigo and Yhwach. And that includes a brand new form.

Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War Episode 5 continues the final fight between Ichigo and Yhwach, and it made a major change to things with the latest episode. While previous changes have extended the events of certain fights or revealed new forms , this latest change has to be the biggest yet as it’s introduced a brand new Bankai form for Ichigo that he never used in the original series. Officially dubbed Blood Chains Ichigo, you can check out Tite Kubo’s official design for the new Bankai below.

Bleach: TYBW Debuts Blood Chains Ichigo Bankai From Tite Kubo

Blood Chains Ichigo is a brand new form that was never seen in Tite Kubo’s original Bleach manga. Around this time in the original depiction of the fight, the manga was quickly heading towards its grand finale. As a true show of power from Yhwach he had interrupted Ichigo before he was able to use his Bankai, but the anime has allowed Ichigo to reach the point where he was able to successfully use this ability and unlock a powerful new form. But it’s still not enough to take on Yhwach’s Almighty power.

Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War has been making all sorts of huge changes to the original version of the manga’s final arc through the first three seasons so far, but we’re about to see even more significant changes now that the anime is heading into its grand finale. With fewer episodes slated for this final season than the others , we’re already at the halfway point of this grand finale and are about to see some major shake ups to everything as a result thanks to how involved Tite Kubo has been with the anime’s production.

How Is Bleach: TYBW Actually Going to End?

It was already exciting to reach this point in Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War as fans have been waiting over ten years for the anime to adapt the manga’s grand finale , but the changes seen with this episode make things even more exciting. The manga notably had a truncated finale that seemed to rush through the final battle, and this is a clear extension to make it last longer. Kubo has been directly involved with all of the changes so far, and that’s most significantly going to be felt for now.

Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War is the best version of the manga’s final arc as been seen through the episodes so far, and it seems to be the most complete version of the story that Kubo has been refining for years at this point. Debuting new forms like this ahead of what could be the end of this very long battle could just be the first in many more surprises to come. Make sure to catch up with it all on Hulu and Hulu on Disney+.

title: Yen Press Reveals 9 New Licenses Including Übel Blatt II, The Gray Exorcist, Seal My Lips With a Kiss Manga
content:
Yen Press announced nine new licenses at its main industry panel at Anime NYC on Saturday, including two light novel series and seven manga series. The company did not give a release window for the new licenses.

The two new light novel licenses include:

Leonardo Nix once dreamed of becoming an alchemist. Instead, he's in a maximum- security prison, languishing in guilt and self-disgust. After all, he admitted to breaking an unspeakable taboo—eating his comrades. Then, not long into his imprisonment, he is suddenly transformed into a hideous monstrosity. He flees the prison as guards sound the alarm, but nowhere is safe for such a terrible beast. And though he doesn't want to hurt anyone, a dark hunger for human flesh stirs within him. When all hope seems lost, he crosses paths with Elena the witch, who offers to find a way to break his curse! Unfortunately, there's a catch: As her familiar, he'll still get blood on his hands...straying even farther from the path of redemption.

Faye Leonheart is a seventeen-year-old sword-fighting prodigy and the heir apparent to the mightiest warrior clan. After three long years, she finally returns from her sword- training pilgrimage...with a magical machine gun in hand?! Promptly disowned by her family with nothing but her beloved firearm for company, this trigger-happy young lady commits herself to studying ancient technology called overgear. After all, who has time for regrets when freedom calls? The world is full of archaic ruins, and Faye is ready to explore them, full-metal style!

The seven new manga licenses include:

“If this comes undone...I don't know what I'll do...”

Kaede's never seen this side of her unassuming STEM coworker, but his words and her position at his mercy start to light a fire in her...!

MangaPlaza is also releasing the manga in English digitally.

Manga UP! Global is also releasing the manga in English digitally.

ANN's coverage of Anime NYC 2026 is sponsored by Yen Press. Whether it's light novels, manga, or manhwa, Yen Press has everything you might want to add to your reading shelves! Visit Booth #1701 or YenPress.com for more information!
